title: Transit-access explainer for >= 1 metro (GTFS, per-feed license verified)
context: There is no blanket GTFS license; each agency feed has its own terms. A transit-access explainer must be built only from feeds whose license individually permits the derivative, with per-feed attribution and resolved output license recorded. The access score must follow the locked transit-method-014 definition exactly, with a harm scan to ensure no 'good/bad place' judgement is implied about any neighbourhood or community.
objective: Build a transit-access explainer for at least one metro using GTFS data, with each feed individually license-gated per gate-003, and the access score following the locked transit-method-014 definition.
acceptanceCriteria: Each GTFS feed used is license-gated individually (gate-003): only feeds whose license permits the derivative are used; restrictive/no-derivative/unclear feeds excluded; per-feed attribution and resolved output license recorded in the committed gate artifact.

Access score follows the locked transit-method-014 definition exactly; Methodology Card documents walk threshold, network vs. straight-line, and frequency weighting; no 'good/bad place' judgement (harm scan passed).
Figures reproduce in CI from committed code + GTFS snapshot; built on the shared toolkit (toolkit-002).
Accessibility pass (WCAG 2.2 AA, reading grade <= 8) and Domain (transport) reviewer sign-off obtained.
License reviewer and Methodology+Stats reviewer sign-offs obtained.
resources: PLAN.md — Data, licensing & compliance (GTFS feeds row)
output: A transit-access explainer for at least one metro (committed static tool + plain-language content + Methodology Card + per-feed gate artifacts + accessibility sign-off + harm-scan record).
